description: Your own tool-call history, newest first: which tool ran, when, whether it worked and why not, how long it took, and the credits it actually took — 0 for a free first use, a refund, a cached answer or a replayed retry. Use it to answer 'where did my credits go' or 'which call produced that' from the record rather than from memory: filter by tool, time window, success or minCredits, and page with before/nextBefore. creditsOnThisPage totals the page. scope:"workspace" shows every member's runs with a userId, and only for the workspace's owner and admins. Error text is shown with credentials scrubbed. No cost to call. Use when a balance moved more than expected, before disputing a charge.

before.description: Page cursor: pass the previous page's nextBefore.

from.description: Only runs at or after this ISO date or timestamp.

minCredits.description: Only runs that took at least this many credits.

scope.description: 'mine' (default) or 'workspace' — every member's runs, for the workspace's owner and admins only.

success.description: true for runs that worked, false for the ones that failed.

to.description: Only runs before this ISO date or timestamp.

tool.description: Only runs of this tool, e.g. 'search_mentions'.

name: list_tool_runs

creditsOnThisPage.description: The credits these runs took, summed.

nextBefore.description: Pass as `before` for the next page; null on the last one.

credits.description: What it actually took: 0 for a free, refunded, cached or replayed call.

error.description: Why it failed, credentials scrubbed; null when it worked.

surface.description: 'mcp' for a connector call, 'chat' for the dashboard's agent.

userId.description: Whose run it was; only in the workspace scope.

title: List Tool Runs
